title: massachsuets — Weather All in One — Boston — today
description:
Boston is at 61°F, and this Massachusetts daily news update looks beyond the weather at the costs and community stories shaping your day. We cover Coldstuff Ice Cream in Blackstone and its owners’ defense of teen staff against alleged customer mistreatment, Massachusetts gasoline prices compared with last year, Boston home prices and selling times, and the latest supplied state jobs figures. We also explain what national grocery inflation means—and why it is not a Boston shopping-basket price. scenes.text: Boston is at 61 degrees Fahrenheit this October seventh. Which everyday expense has climbed faster than groceries? Let's start with your driving costs.
scenes.subject: boston harbor

scenes.text: Massachusetts regular gasoline averages about four dollars and thirty-five cents per gallon today across the state.
scenes.subject: gas station

scenes.text: Last October seventh, that statewide average was about three dollars and six cents per gallon.
scenes.subject: gas pump

scenes.text: It's still below the June 2022 record: about five dollars and five cents per gallon.
scenes.subject: fuel nozzle

scenes.text: Buying in Boston? The median home sale price was $859,431 across all home types in the three months ending August 2026.
scenes.subject: boston homes

scenes.text: That's a sale price, not your mortgage payment. Your financing and down payment still matter.
